description: Compare two Atlas assets by id or ticker. Returns seven side-by-side rows: taxonomy stage, issuer involvement, custody and backing, distributions, voting, legal status and redemption. Each row includes the value, detail and source identifiers for both assets. Each new execution reads https://atlas.weverlabs.com/api/assets and returns the dataset version, catalog counts and retrieval evidence. POST /api/atlas-compare. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the existing shared 10 signed-wallet free calls over rolling 30 days. X-Wever-Wallet-Proof binds the exact JSON arguments to this API path. Read-only rights analysis and API access billing are separate: the billing layer records shared free usage or settles the caller-supplied payment authorization. Read /api/atlas-rights-contract and the backend 402 body for schemas and billing terms.
